items.title: Show HN: A bot attack forced me to rebuild my tools on Cloudflare Workers
items.author: kagouhui
items.descZh: Site Tools Box近期遭遇恶意bot攻击，导致流量异常，攻击者针对提交页面进行暴力破解。为应对威胁，网站强化了安全架构，实施即时IP blocking系统、将死链检查功能卸载到Cloudflare边缘网络，并确保工具在用户浏览器本地运行。这些措施提升了性能和安全性，例如扫描最多300个链接在边缘运行，更快更稳定。网站继续提供免费、无需登录的工具，适用于webmasters进行死链检查、WHOIS查询等场景。
items.quote: 我们的核心承诺没有改变：免费工具、无强制注册、无废话。

items.title: Show HN: Logcrux – An intelligent local log analyzer
items.desc: description: logcrux finds real incidents across 200+ log formats (web servers, databases, containers, cloud, Linux/Unix system logs, and more), entirely on your machine. No cloud, no telemetry, no account. title: logcrux: intelligent, fully local log analyzer _ ___ __ _ ___ _ __ _ ___ __ / _ \ / _ / __ '__ \ \/ / (_) (_ (__ _ < _\___/ \__, \____ \__,_/_/\_\ ___/ an intelligent, fully local log analyzer. point it at a log, it tells you what's actually wrong. works on any text log, and natively understands 200+ web, database, container, cloud, security, and Linux/Unix systemlog formats. no cloud. no telemetry. no account. uv tool install python 3.12 logcrux and go. \[ Apache2.0 \] \[ Python ≥3.11 or uvx \] \[ runs unprivileged \] \[ works offline \] [logcrux](index.html) / home [home](index.html) [install](install.html) [usage](usage.html) [formats](formats.html) [how it works](howitworks.html) [config](config.html) [troubleshooting](troubleshooting.html) [faq](faq.html) [source](https://github.com/ravipatip/logcrux) what is this logcrux reads a log file (nginx, postgres, kubernetes, syslog, auth, whatever) and tells you if something is actually wrong. Bursts and spikes, yes, but also the failures that are a single line: a crashed backend, a backup job that did not run, an app that died on an unhandled exception, an expired certificate, a disk that went readonly, a proxy with no live backend, a process out of file descriptors. Every finding says what it is about (the attacking IPs and users, the process the OOM killer chose, the unit that crashed) and points at the log lines, by number, that prove it. A clean result says what was checked. Everything runs on your machine. No server component, no API key, no log data ever leaves the box it runs on. Point it at a file, or pipe a stream into it: $ logcrux /var/log/syslog $ logcrux /var/log/nginx/ $ journalctl b logcrux $ docker logs myapp 2&1 logcrux $ kubectl logs deploy/api previous logcrux See [install](install.html) to get it running and [usage](usage.html) for the full command reference. example output An actual run against a server's journal after a bad afternoon: an OOM kill, a crashlooping service, a rejected nginx config and an SSH brute force. $ journalctl b logcrux ╭──────────────────────── CRITICAL Out of Memory ─────────────────────────╮ │ ● OOM killer fired (6 events) │ │ 20261019 19:41:55 → 19:42:14 (19s) │ │ killed: tail ×2 · cgroup: /system.slice/reportexport.service ×1 │ │ line 1443: kernel: Memory cgroup out of memory: Killed process 17110 (… │ │ line 1444: systemd: reportexport.service: A process of this unit has … │ │ ● Service crashed (10 events) │ │ 20261019 19:41:55 → 19:42:52 (57s) │ │ process: tail ×1 · unit: ordersworker.service ×6, reportexport.serv… │ │ line 1530: systemd: ordersworker.service: Main process exited, code=e… │ │ line 1571: systemd: Failed to start orders worker. │ │ ● Configuration rejected (1 event) │ │ at 20261019 19:42:52 │ │ line 1607: nginx: configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf test failed │ │ ● Authentication failure cluster (60 events) │ │ 20261019 19:41:58 → 19:42:11 (13s) │ │ ● Error burst detected (77 events) │ │ 20261019 19:38:06 → 19:42:52 (4m46s) │ │ │ │ Confidence: 90% │ │ │ │ Remediation: Check /proc/meminfo and dmesg grep i oom. Consider adding │ │ swap or tuning vm.overcommit_memory=2 in /etc/sysctl.conf. │ ╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯ Checked 1,611 events as syslog │ 100% of 1,620 lines parsed │ 20261019 19:37:49 → 19:43:02 (5m13s) │ 78 error · 1 warning Analyzed 1,611 events in 0.5s │ 5 incident(s) │ logcrux v0.10.0 $ echo $? 4 No incident, no news: a clean run prints a brief CLEAN box and exits 0\. See [usage](usage.html) for exit codes and [how it works](howitworks.html) for the pipeline behind this. why local logs are often the most sensitive data on a box; they should not have to leave it to be understood no API key, no account, no perseat pricing, no rate limit works on an airgapped machine exactly as well as an internetconnected one fully open source, Apache2.0, no telemetry to audit because there isn't any runs unprivileged, reading a log file is all it needs See the [full list](formats.html) of formats. Anything unrecognized still gets parsed by a generic fallback that never silently drops a line. logcrux is free and open source software, licensed [Apache2.0](https://github.com/ravipatip/logcrux/blob/main/LICENSE). This site sets no cookies and runs no scripts. logcrux itself sends nothing anywhere, ever. [source on github](https://github.com/ravipatip/logcrux) · [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/logcrux/) · [report a security issue](https://github.com/ravipatip/logcrux/security/advisories/new)
items.author: ravipatib
items.descZh: logcrux是一款完全本地的日志分析工具，旨在处理敏感日志数据，确保数据不离开用户机器，无需云服务、遥测或账户，符合数据隐私需求。其核心功能是读取和分析200多种日志格式，包括Web服务器、数据库、容器和系统日志，自动识别真实问题如服务崩溃、内存不足或认证失败，并提供详细报告指出具体日志行。亮点在于高效性能，例如在实际运行中，它能在0.5秒内分析1611个事件，解析100%的日志行，并检测出多个关键事件，如OOM杀戮和错误爆发，同时给出置信度和修复建议。适用场景广泛，适用于服务器、容器、系统日志等环境，支持离线操作和命令行管道输入，适合安全敏感或空气隔离的系统。
items.quote: 指向日志，它会告诉你到底哪里出了问题。
items.titleZh: Show HN：Logcrux – 智能本地日志分析器

items.author: lutun
items.descZh: clap.cpp 是一款基于纯 C++ 和 ggml 框架构建的高性能音频嵌入推理工具，旨在为开发者提供轻量级、跨平台的音频特征提取方案。其核心功能支持 CLAP、MuQ、CLaMP3 和 MERT 等多种主流音频模型，能够自动处理 WAV、MP3 和 FLAC 格式音频的重采样与多声道混合。项目亮点在于提供了 Python、Node.js 和 Rust 的多语言绑定，其中 Python 和 Rust 绑定支持 CPU、CUDA 和 Vulkan 加速，模型嵌入维度覆盖 224 至 1024 维。该工具非常适合需要本地部署、高效音频检索、音乐分类及多模态语义匹配的应用场景。
items.quote: Audio embedding inference in pure C++ supports CLAP, MuQ, CLaMP3 and MERT with Python, Node and Rust bindings

items.title: Show HN: A diffusion model that runs in pure CSS, no JavaScript
items.desc: description: A denoising diffusion model that runs entirely in CSS. No JavaScript. title: diffusion.css image: https://metrix187.github.io/diffusion.css/preview.png diffusion.css A diffusion model that runs entirely in CSS. No JavaScript, no WebAssembly, no images. Press the button: the stylesheet freezes a seed, turns it into noise, and denoises that into a 16×16 sprite in 12 steps. This browser lacks :has(), which the page needs. Try a current Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari. replay 202,863weights 12sampler steps 5.2 MBof CSS 0lines of JS How it works 1. Seed. An @property integer counts up inside a keyframe animation. Ticking the hidden checkbox pauses it, so the moment you press is the random seed. 2. Noise. Each of the 768 pixel channels hashes that seed with mod() and sums four draws into roughly Gaussian noise. That is the static on screen before you press. 3. Model. 11 small neural networks, one per noise level, trained in PyTorch on ten handdrawn sprites recoloured to random hues, then pruned and rounded to integers. All 202,863 weights are written out as literals inside calc(). 4. Sampling. 12 DDIM steps, unrolled. Every intermediate value is its own @property <integer register, 12,518 in all, so the browser computes each once and rounds it. 5. Timeline. One @keyframes rule points the 256 pixel elements at each sampler state in turn. Nothing is prerendered: a different seed gives a different sprite and colour. 6. Check it. View source. There is no <script, and a Python reference using the same integer arithmetic produces identical pixels for the same seed. [Source, training code and a reference sampler](https://github.com/Metrix187/diffusion.css)

items.descZh: diffusion.css 是一个创新的去噪扩散模型，完全基于 CSS 实现，无需 JavaScript、WebAssembly 或图片，展示了浏览器样式表的计算潜力。其核心功能是通过用户触发按钮，冻结随机种子并经过 12 步去噪过程，实时生成 16×16 像素的精灵图。亮点包括模型使用 202,863 个权重参数，全部以字面量形式嵌入 CSS 文件中，仅占用 5.2 MB 大小，且实现零行 JavaScript 代码，性能高效。该产品适用于轻量级 Web 动画、教育演示或无需脚本的交互场景，特别适合探索 CSS 极限能力的开发者。它基于 PyTorch 训练的神经网络，通过整数算术确保跨浏览器一致性，为无 JavaScript 环境提供了新的创意工具。
items.quote: 一个完全用 CSS 运行的扩散模型。无需 JavaScript，无需 WebAssembly，无需图片。

items.author: Wayy01
items.descZh: JustDashboard 是一个面向 Linux 服务器的开源控制面板，旨在将服务器管理功能统一到一个私有 Web 界面中。它支持 Docker 容器编排、应用部署、数据库管理、网络配置、SSL 证书签发以及内置终端和文件管理，无需依赖云服务或付费订阅。项目采用 AGPL-3.0 协议，当前版本为 0.8.5，完全免费且自托管，所有数据均存储在用户自己的服务器上。其安装过程通过一条命令即可完成，支持 Tailscale 或 SSH 隧道两种安全访问方式，配置灵活。适合开发者、运维人员或小型团队在自有服务器上构建私有云平台，替代传统面板如宝塔或 Portainer。通过 GitHub 贡献代码是参与项目的主要方式，仓库已积累超过 3,300 次提交，社区活跃。

items.desc: description: Enter any website and see which pages it added or updated in the last 30 days, based on its public sitemap. Free, no signup. title: Free Website Change Checker · Competitor Radar image: https://lifeadminpilot.com/static/og.png What did this website publish recently? Enter any website. We list the pages it added or updated in the last 30 days, based on its public sitemap. Scan What this tool shows you A competitor's website is one of the best public signals of what they're working on. New pricing pages, comparison pages, industry pages and product launches usually show up on the site before anyone announces them. This tool gives you a quick snapshot: every page the site says it added or updated in the last 30 days, newest first. It's useful for checking a competitor before a sales call, a planning meeting, or a pricing change of your own. If you want to keep watching, the [weekly briefing](/) does this for you every Monday and explains what the changes likely mean. Frequently asked questions How does this website change checker work? Most websites publish a sitemap: a file that lists their pages and when each one was last updated. We read that public sitemap and list the pages dated within the last 30 days. We don't log in, fill in forms, or read anything that isn't public. Why are some dates wrong? The dates come from the website's own sitemap. Some sites update every date whenever they redeploy, and some never update them. Treat the list as a strong hint, not proof. Our weekly briefing compares real snapshots of the sitemap from week to week, so it only reports pages that actually appeared or disappeared. Why can't some websites be scanned? If a site blocks automated access in its robots.txt file, we respect that and don't scan it. Some sites also have no sitemap, or hide it in a place we can't find. Do you read private pages or pages behind a login? No. We only read the public sitemap and the public pages listed in it. We make at most one request per second to a site and never try to get around blocks. Our crawler identifies itself with its own user agent, explained on the About our crawler page. How do I track a competitor's website every week? Sign up on the home page and add up to 5 competitors for free. Every Monday you get one short email with the pages they added or removed, what the changes likely mean, and whether you should care. Weeks with no meaningful changes are skipped.
